qualifier: canonical NLRP1, NLRP3 and AIM2 sensors
name: Canonical inflammasome IL-1/IL-18 maturation and pyroptosis
rationale: All members concern inflammasome assembly, IL-1/IL-18 precursor processing and signalling, and pyroptotic death; the NLRP1/NLRP3/AIM2 and P2X7-purinergic members set it apart from the caspase-4/5 non-canonical and IPAF confusables and from the IL-1-restraining Toll confusables.

core: VEGF receptor and Tie2 signaling in endothelium
qualifier: endothelial survival and lymphatic specification
name: VEGFR and Tie2 signaling in endothelial and lymphatic specification
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR2/neuropilin and Tie/Tie2 signalling with endothelial fate, survival and lymphatic differentiation, whereas confusables centre on sprouting angiogenesis regulation or arterial/venous vessel morphogenesis.

qualifier: CCR7-driven homing
name: CCR7-driven dendritic cell maturation and chemotaxis
rationale: Members cover conventional DC maturation, survival and chemotaxis with CCR7 signalling, Cdc42 and PLC/PKC relays and lymphocyte homing, while confusables are general chemokine clusters or B/T cell and CXCR4 migration.

qualifier: thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol
name: Thiamine, riboflavin, vitamin E and ubiquinol metabolism
rationale: All members concern transport or metabolism of thiamine, riboflavin, tocopherol or the quinone ubiquinol, distinguishing it from confusables built on cobalamin/biotin, methionine/choline or folate metabolism.

qualifier: fate specification of oligodendrocytes, astrocytes and Schwann cells
name: Glial fate specification and oligodendrocyte/astrocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate glial fate choice, oligodendrocyte and astrocyte differentiation, Schwann cell proliferation and myelination onset, unlike confusables about neuronal/neuroblast differentiation or mature myelin maintenance and gliosis.

qualifier: Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host restriction of entry and release
name: HIV Nef/Vpu receptor downregulation and host restriction
rationale: Members are HIV Nef/Vpu-mediated ubiquitin-dependent removal of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC I plus host suppression of virion entry and release, separating it from HIV reverse transcription and from proteasome, PD-L1 and MHC I presentation confusables.

core: 3'-UTR control of mRNA stability and translation
qualifier: HuR/AUF1 binding and L13a translational silencing
name: HuR/AUF1 mRNA stability and L13a translational silencing
rationale: Members concern 3'-UTR-dependent mRNA stabilisation/destabilisation, localisation and translational repression via HuR, AUF1 and L13a, whereas confusables involve TTP/BRF1/KSRP decay with stress granules or ADAR RNA editing.

qualifier: von Willebrand factor-platelet adhesion variants
name: Coagulation, fibrinolysis and von Willebrand factor platelet adhesion
rationale: Members span the coagulation cascade, fibrin formation and plasminogen-mediated clot dissolution plus VWF variant binding/cleavage, distinguishing it from confusables on factor V, factor VIII/IX defects or the FXII/kallikrein contact pathway.

qualifier: lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
name: Chemokine-guided leukocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development
rationale: Members cover chemokine receptor and S1P signalling, Rac/Cdc42 motility and homing of DC, B, T, NK and mast cells into lymph nodes and MALT, unlike confusables centred on integrin-mediated migration or monocyte chemokines and T cell extravasation.

qualifier: beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP crosstalk
name: Wnt/beta-catenin destruction complex and Hippo-YAP signaling
rationale: Members are canonical and non-canonical Wnt signalling, destruction-complex cancer mutants and Wnt secretion together with Hippo/YAP-TAZ, separating it from TGF-beta, Notch/Hedgehog and planar cell polarity confusables.

qualifier: LIF, CNTF, IL-11 and oncostatin M
name: IL-6-family cytokine (LIF, CNTF, IL-11) STAT signaling
rationale: Members concern gp130 cytokines LIF, CNTF, IL-11 and OSM, their receptors and STAT activation, whereas confusables are IL-6 itself with ERK, common gamma-chain/STAT5 cytokines, or generic autocrine/paracrine signalling.

qualifier: laminin and collagen with dystroglycan complex and proteoglycans
name: Basement membrane laminin, collagen and dystroglycan interactions
rationale: Members are laminin, collagen trimerisation/anchoring fibrils, integrin and proteoglycan interactions plus dystroglycan complex and AChR clustering, distinguishing it from hemidesmosome, collagen crosslinking/elastic fibre and myogenesis confusables.

qualifier: TAK1-driven p38 and JNK cascades
name: TAK1-driven p38 and JNK stress kinase cascade regulation
rationale: Members regulate p38 and JNK activation downstream of TAK1, TNF and ALPK1, separating it from NOD1/2 sensing, ERK/AP-1 feedback and upstream TLR-TAK1 complex assembly confusables.

qualifier: deoxynucleotide breakdown, nucleotide pool sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
name: Purine (deoxy)nucleotide catabolism, sanitization and thiopurine metabolism
rationale: Members cover purine (deoxy)nucleoside/nucleotide breakdown via ADA, PNP and NUDT hydrolases to allantoin plus TPMT/azathioprine handling, unlike de novo/salvage purine synthesis and pyrimidine catabolism confusables.

qualifier: desmosomes and hemidesmosomes linked to intermediate filaments
name: Desmosome and hemidesmosome intermediate-filament anchoring junctions
rationale: Members concern desmosome and hemidesmosome assembly, intermediate filament bundling, anchoring fibrils/laminin and cardiomyocyte adhesion, distinguishing it from adherens/apical junction, integrin-only and cornified envelope confusables.

qualifier: Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 intracellular domain release
name: Intramembrane proteolysis of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 receptors
rationale: Members are gamma-secretase-type cleavage releasing intracellular domains of Notch, p75NTR and ERBB4 and their nuclear signalling, whereas confusables centre on Notch target transcription.

qualifier: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy defects
name: Sanfilippo, Morquio and Maroteaux-Lamy glycosaminoglycan degradation
rationale: Members are heparan, keratan and chondroitin sulfate degradation and the MPS III, IV and VI disorders, separating it from confusables built on Hurler, Hunter, Sly and Natowicz types.

core: Transcriptional regulation of adhesion and TGF-beta receptor genes
qualifier: CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3
name: Transcriptional regulation of cadherin and TGFBR3 genes
rationale: Members are Pol II transcriptional control (largely repression) of CDH1, CDH11 and TGFBR3, distinguishing it from confusables about DNA-binding regulation, mesenchymal BMP programmes, EMT or RUNX3.

qualifier: ribosome-associated mRNA and nascent protein quality control
name: Cytosolic translation cycle and ribosome-associated quality control
rationale: Members span translation initiation, elongation and termination with ribosome rescue, RQC, NMD and no-go decay, distinguishing it from nuclear RNA processing and translation-factor modification confusables.

qualifier: MutS/MutL gene defects
name: DNA mismatch repair and MutS/MutL gene defects
rationale: All members concern mismatch repair, including MLH1, MSH2, MSH3 and MSH6 deficiency and meiotic MMR, unlike the double-strand break repair confusables.

qualifier: isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
name: Germinal center isotype switching and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members cover germinal centre B and Tfh differentiation, IgG/IgA class switching and plasma cell/immunoglobulin signatures, distinguishing it from BCR signalling and B cell development confusables.

qualifier: second heart field, outflow tract and great arteries
name: Second heart field, outflow tract and great artery morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern second heart field specification, heart tube patterning, neural crest-dependent outflow tract septation and pharyngeal, pulmonary and coronary artery morphogenesis, unlike valve, atrial or conduction system confusables.

qualifier: neutrophil, eosinophil and mast cell commitment
name: Granulocyte, eosinophil and mast cell differentiation
rationale: Members drive myeloid progenitors toward neutrophils, eosinophils and mast cells via G-CSF/GM-CSF, RUNX1 and retinoid programmes, distinguishing it from monocyte/macrophage, negative-regulation and promyelocyte confusables.

qualifier: primitive and definitive waves with progenitor transcriptional control
name: Primitive and definitive erythropoiesis and transcriptional control
rationale: Most members concern primitive and definitive erythrocyte differentiation, post-embryonic haematopoiesis and HSC differentiation control, separating it from HSC homeostasis, promyelocyte and terminal erythroid/megakaryocytic confusables.

qualifier: ovulation, luteal phase and progesterone
name: Ovulation, corpus luteum function and progesterone signaling
rationale: Members cover the estrous cycle, ovulation, luteinization, luteolysis and progesterone synthesis/response, distinguishing it from gonadotropin, follicle growth and male gonad confusables.
